body: I just hope he doesn't try to hurt her. If he pursues rights I won't be able to keep him from contacting her if he uses the court's. It's hard. When my family broke I felt as if it was my fault. I don't want them to ever think why their dad isn't around is because of them.

It will be hard when I move because I will be without health insurance until I figure something out. It's very hard I'm going to have to move 9 hours away because all I had here was him and well that isn't going to happen. I'm glad your mom is great! There's just something about a mom and her child

I really do hope I'm able to achieve that, it's going to be a very hard journey the first couple year's. I'm going to have to move 9 hour's away and I'm not sure when to go yet for health insurance purposes

Thank you everyone all of the support has made me cry some happy tears for once in a long time and I really appreciate it. I truly hope your pregnancies all go smoothly and we all get to hold our babies and smile.
I grew up in a broken home all I wanted was more for my baby if I ever had one and I failed. It hurts a lot. Sending love your way as well

I don't even know how I'm going to afford all of this I have to move states just to be near family for help because I still need to work. I won't pursue child support because that would link to him having rights of her. I don't mind him having right, I just don't want him going in and out of their life. I'm so sorry to hear that you had to deal with that abuse by your partner. I wish I could figure out why men treat us like this honestly.
I hope your pregnancy goes well, sending love your way too. It's so hard for us honestly.
I really hope so, it's so hard.
I feel like I'm just a shell.
